classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

assumptions: The user intends to use specific GO terms for 'ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase' and 'NADPHX epimerase' activity, but did not provide them in the request.

The workflow will proceed by retrieving sequences for a generic 'NAD(P)HX repair' GO term if specific activity terms are unavailable, or the user must supply the specific GO IDs to execute the retrieval step.
Sequence analysis will be performed at physiological pH (7.4) unless specified otherwise.
The final ranking will be based on the sequence analysis outputs (composition, charge, motifs) and any available QC data.
plan.goal: Retrieve representative protein sequences annotated with GO terms related to NAD(P)HX repair, analyze their biochemical properties (composition, charge, motifs), and rank the top candidates based on these analyses.
missing_inputs: GO term ID for 'ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase' activity
GO term ID for 'NADPHX epimerase' activity
success_criteria: Successfully retrieve a list of FASTA sequences for the specified GO term.
Generate a detailed sequence analysis report including composition, charge, and motifs for all retrieved sequences.
Produce a ranked list of top N representative sequences based on the analysis metrics.
